messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval: RAG retrieval recall dropped ~18% on `dev_rag_prompts` (compare baseline: 0.84 -> 0.69). Failing slices: multi-hop Qs and short-context FAQs. report: https://ci.redwood/ev/1778001112
Maria: ugh, that’s pretty large. any recent infra/model changes around 02:00 UTC?
Alex: pushed a small reranker weight change in PR #4920 around 01:50 (alpha -> beta routing). Not a full rollout but can affect ranking. Commit: 8f3b7c2.
Sam: copying quick stats from my local run: embedding cosine mean for queries dropped from 0.78 -> 0.61 on the dev slice. std increased too.
Maria: can you paste an example query + topk ids?
Sam: sure:
```
query: "How do I rotate API keys without downtime?"
baseline topk: [doc_239, doc_412, doc_88] scores: [0.92,0.87,0.81]
now topk: [doc_701, doc_88, doc_239] scores: [0.60,0.59,0.58]
```
Maria: that looks like the reranker moved doc_701 up despite lower embed score. Did reranker feature inputs change?
Oli: checked infra changelog: we deployed a quantized embedder binary (q-enc v2) at 01:40 to reduce memory; it had a different normalization pipeline (we normalized in fp16 now). Could be related.
Alex: reranker change was only adjusting score blending coefficient (embedding weight 0.7 -> 0.45). Combined with lower cosine scores from quantized embedder, the reranker ended up preferring BM25-ish signals.
Jen: I repro'd locally: with q-enc v2 + reranker alpha=0.45, recall@5 drops to 0.66. If I revert alpha to 0.7 it goes back to ~0.82.
Maria: so two levers changed concurrently = multiplicative effect. Was the vector index rebuilt after q-enc deploy? If embeddings changed shape/scale we might need a reindex.
Sam: vector-store metadata shows last rebuild 2026-01-05 (before this deploy). But keys are stable; embeddings were replaced in-place during batch update that ran at 01:30 — I see partial job logs: some partitions failed and retried. Could have stale vectors for some doc_shards.
Alex: combination hypothesis: (1) embedder numeric shift (norm/scaling) -> reduced cosines, (2) reranker lower embedding weight -> more weight on doc signals, (3) incomplete index refresh -> mixed-old+new vectors.
Maria: plan: revert reranker alpha to 0.7 on canary, force full vector-store rebuild for dev index, and run eval-bot quick-run. Also produce histogram of cosines pre/post. Owners: Alex -> reranker revert, Sam -> vector rebuild, Jen -> regression eval harness. ETA 2h?
Oli: rapid check: pushing canary revert now to region us-west-2. will update.
Alex: reverted alpha on canary (deploy 1778001280).
Sam: kicked off full rebuild job (job id: rebuild-1778001283). watching logs, ETA ~45m per shard.
Jen: I added a small comparison harness to isolate embedder-only vs reranker-only effects. Running embedder-only (q-enc v2 + baseline reranker alpha) -> recall@5 0.74. Reranker-only change (old embedder + alpha=0.45) -> 0.79. Both together -> 0.66. So both contribute.
Maria: good breakdown. For immediate mitigation: revert reranker (done for canary), requeue full rebuild, and roll back q-enc v2 on prod until we confirm normalization parity. Also add a post-deploy check: embed distribution mean/var alert.
Alex: filing follow-ups: #1 PR to add automatic normalization test in CI for q-enc; #2 fix reranker rollout gating so embedding model changes block weight rollouts.
Sam: rebuild finished for dev index at 1778001449. Quick eval shows recall@5 jumped to 0.81 on canary + reverted alpha.
Eval-bot: quick-rerun complete: recall@5 = 0.82 (canary), 0.67 (prod mixed). Diff: +15% on dev slice.
Maria: nice. Closing loop: owners assigned in ticket ENGML-629. Action items in ticket: rollback q-enc in prod, add CI norm test, gated reranker rollout, add index-consistency check post-embed-deploy.
Jen: I'll schedule a postmortem sync tomorrow 10am. cc @eng-ml.
Alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Oli: leaving logs and the minimal repro (query + doc ids) in the ticket.
Maria: moving this thread to incidents if we need to escalate. For now, monitoring.
